description: cam run verifies Claude Code login/subscription at startup and fails fast with a clear message before spawning the sidecar or orchestrator panes.

officialDocsConsulted.summary: Verified live against installed claude 2.1.195: `claude auth status --json` (--json is the default) returns exit 0 with JSON {loggedIn, authMethod, apiProvider, email, orgId, orgName, subscriptionType} when logged in. Gate on loggedIn===true (hard gate); surface subscriptionType informationally only (valid plan set unknown, do NOT hard-gate it). Fast + non-interactive. Do NOT use `claude --version` (does not check auth) and do NOT use `claude -p` (forbidden in this project).

userStories.title: Add checkClaudeAuth preflight with injectable spawn
userStories.description: As the cam run command, I need a fast non-interactive preflight that confirms the operator is logged in to Claude Code (active subscription) and returns a structured ok | fail-with-reason result, so the loop never starts blind into a silent pre-session worker death.
acceptanceCriteria: A new exported function (e.g. checkClaudeAuth) accepts an injectable spawn function (repo SpawnFn / spawnSync DI seam, mirroring the claude-on-PATH pattern in src/commands/init.ts) and runs `claude auth status --json`. [oracle: grep -q "claude.*auth.*status" src/commands/run.ts || grep -rq "auth.*status" src/commands/]
The probe hard-gates on `loggedIn === true` parsed from the JSON stdout; a logged-in JSON payload yields an ok result. [oracle: bun test test/commands/run-auth-preflight.test.ts]

`subscriptionType` is surfaced in the ok/diagnostic result (informational only) and is NEVER used as a hard gate (any subscriptionType value with loggedIn:true passes). [oracle: bun test test/commands/run-auth-preflight.test.ts]
loggedIn:false yields a fail result carrying a clear actionable message (e.g. mentioning `claude auth login`). [oracle: bun test test/commands/run-auth-preflight.test.ts]
A non-zero exit from the probe yields a fail result with a clear message (fail-closed). [oracle: bun test test/commands/run-auth-preflight.test.ts]
Unparseable or empty stdout yields a fail result with a clear message (fail-closed). [oracle: bun test test/commands/run-auth-preflight.test.ts]
A `claude`-not-on-PATH / spawn-error condition yields a fail result with a clear message (fail-closed). [oracle: bun test test/commands/run-auth-preflight.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
userStories.notes: New unit test file: test/commands/run-auth-preflight.test.ts (mirror the injected-spawn fake in test/run.test.ts and the spawnSync claude pattern in src/commands/init.ts validateClaude/lookupOnPath ~lines 76-118). Put the preflight in src/commands/run.ts (or a small sibling module imported by run.ts). Use the SpawnFn type from src/tmux/session.ts (the same DI seam RunOptions.spawnFn already uses). The probe must NOT use `claude -p` (forbidden, memory: subscription-only) and must NOT use `claude --version` (does not check auth). JSON shape verified live (claude 2.1.195): {loggedIn, authMethod, apiProvider, email, orgId, orgName, subscriptionType}. Guard array/JSON-field access for noUncheckedIndexedAccess. Use spawnSync with encoding:'utf8' (or pipe stdio) so stdout is readable, mirroring init.ts. Fail-closed default: if login cannot be confirmed for ANY reason, return fail.

userStories.title: Wire auth preflight into runRun before session + sidecar spawn
userStories.description: As the operator, I need cam run to run the auth preflight at startup BEFORE it creates the tmux session, spawns the sidecar, or sets up panes, so that on failure I get a clear message and a non-zero exit with no loop wedged into the no-progress backoff.
acceptanceCriteria: runRun calls the US-001 preflight after the existing tmux/orchestrator-file pre-flight checks and BEFORE setupOrchestratorSession (session creation), spawnSidecar, and pane setup. [oracle: grep -q "checkClaudeAuth" src/commands/run.ts]
On preflight failure, runRun calls printError with a clear actionable message and returns a non-zero exit code. [oracle: bun test test/run.test.ts]

On preflight failure, the session-setup and sidecar-spawn paths are NOT invoked: no tmux new-session / split-window / respawn-pane is spawned and the injected spawnSidecarFn is never called (ordering/short-circuit guard). [oracle: bun test test/run.test.ts]
On a passing preflight, the existing startup flow (session create/attach + sidecar) is unchanged: the prior run tests still pass. [oracle: bun test test/run.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Full quality spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Edit src/commands/run.ts: insert the preflight call inside runRun after the tmux-available (~523) and subagent-orchestrator.md (~530) checks, BEFORE projectSessionName/setupOrchestratorSession (~557) and the result.created sidecar block (~586). The preflight must use the SAME spawnFn that runRun already resolves from options.spawnFn (default spawnSync) so tests can inject it. Note: the existing makeFakeSpawn in test/run.test.ts only stubs `tmux`; the regression test must inject a spawn that ALSO answers the `claude auth status --json` probe (return loggedIn:true for the pass-path tests; loggedIn:false or non-zero for the new failure test). Add a regression test asserting: failing probe => return code != 0, spawnSidecarFn (inject a recording fake) never called, and no tmux new-session/split-window in spawn.calls. Use printError (src/logging/color.ts, stderr, blank line + destructive bold ✗ + muted hint) for the failure message, matching the existing tmux/orchestrator-file failure paths. Honor CAM_RUN_DRY_RUN ordering: decide whether the dry-run path runs the preflight (recommend yes, so dry-run still validates auth) but keep it consistent with the existing dry-run early-return at ~549.
